lines.text: Really, and I'm not hiding it.
I highkey love this new album.

data.mean: Really, and I'm not hiding it.
data.define: Used to say something strongly and openly. It's the opposite of lowkey.

example.text: I highkey love this new album.

misuse.text: Don't say 'highkey' in a formal presentation.
